messages:
lee: quick note — onboarding sample using json_mode + function calls caused duplicate DB inserts when python SDK retried a stream after a 401.

ana: ah ok. JS didn't show that because it doesn't retry streaming by default.

lee: repro: start stream, auth refresh triggers a replay of buffered chunks, function_call chunk delivered twice and handler ran twice.

carter: can we short-term disable stream retries in py SDK and add a test?

lee: opened PR with test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/497 (disable stream retry default).

ana: also noticed our schema validator failed on valid JSON when keys were out of order — the docs generator baked examples with ordered keys.

carter: fix = canonicalize keys before validation in both SDKs. I'll take it.

bot-ci: CI passed for pr-497 on staging (2026-03-20T11:22:00Z) :white_check_mark:

ana: follow-ups: (1) update onboarding sample to recommend idempotent handlers with idempotency token (2) RFC for optional call_id in function_call events for dedupe.

lee: thanks all, will push changelog note and customer notification if we flip the default. :thumbsup:
